scope: Archived displacement-Aitken cross-validation and subsequent scale-guard audit. This scalar interface case remains discoverable and its reference is used by maintained regression tests. Independent method transcription is not an external solver rerun; no fresh scientific acceptance.

criteria.pass_rule: K1, K2, K4 and K6 must be < 15% for the aligned arms (ours_life_conv vs life_ref); K5 must be true
criteria.iteration_cost_rule: a K3 difference between ours_life_conv and life_ref larger than 15% must be attributed to a listed convention difference (predictor, start factor, tolerance normalisation, clipping) or reported as an implementation defect; K3 is diagnostic, not an accuracy gate
criteria.physical_accuracy_rule: K2 < 3% is reported explicitly against the owner's stricter 3% question
criteria.stability_rule: non-finite interface state or |d| > 1e6 * (F0/k) is a failure, reported as measured, never tuned away
